protocol.acceptance_criterion: strictly positive R2 margin over the maximum matched control and training-mean constant in every seed, fixed projection, A/B and all four C suffixes; report seedwise minimum margin without automatic scientific-status promotion
protocol.claim_boundary: fresh-corpus frozen-probe transfer after a prescribed channelwise transform; no native calibration, causal channel, utility, learning, or adaptation claim

conditions.base: A: six evidence plus 32 delay frames
conditions.delay_plus_two: B: identical six evidence plus 34 delay frames
conditions.neutral_cue_plus_two: C: identical six evidence plus every two-symbol reliability-0.5 suffix plus 32 delay frames

protocol.falsifier: any failed sensitivity ends the radial-normalization branch; causal channel intervention remains gated
protocol.fit_scope: train-family A only; fixed projections, train-only standardization and coefficients reused for heldout A/B/all C suffixes
protocol.independent_unit: model seed; histories, projections and suffixes are dependent sensitivity conditions
protocol.primary_target: six-event public log odds, copied unchanged across paired variants
protocol.primary_transform: normalize each actual checkpoint-state channel vector by its own L2 norm and concatenate in V1_CHANNELS order; zero channels remain zero; no shared-width assumption, labels, or test-distribution statistics
protocol.shuffle_conditioning: training labels permuted within sorted reliability multiset and final symbol/reliability groups; fit on identically channel-normalized features
